device_entry.name_en: Passive Monitoring GUI and Communication Component
tags: 环境控制与稳定性测试

device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于被动监测实验中的仪器通信与图形界面控制。它负责连接并协调 Keithley 2400 与 Lake Shore 仪器，执行实验配置、读取测量数据、记录日志，以及管理界面状态与实验流程。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for instrument communication and GUI control in passive monitoring experiments. It connects and coordinates a Keithley 2400 and a Lake Shore instrument, handling experiment configuration, measurement retrieval, logging, and UI workflow management.
